description: Turn a structured clip plan into a sectioned video prompt (style, references, world, camera, timestamped beats with a living tail, title, sound, continuity) and check it before any paid run: beats past the duration, overlaps, a title after the end, a cut inside a one-shot, an unknown @image tag. startbar=false means a hard finding. `anschluss` is the opening for the NEXT clip of a chain; pass the previous plan as `vorher` to get the opening this clip inherits. Free, no model call. Paste `prompt` into lab_animate or lab_verkettung.

beats.description: Timestamped action beats in seconds, in order, inside the duration

figuren.description: Exactly how many characters are in the shot

kamera.description: ONE camera move; the plan adds 'No zoom, no cut'

lebendes_ende.description: Append a living tail instead of a freeze at the end

details.description: Props and identity details to keep

stil.description: Style line, e.g. '1930s rubber hose cartoon, squash and stretch, animated on twos'

titel.description: Title drawn into the frame, exact spelling, in/out seconds
